title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-4o, bringing real-time voice conversation to everyone
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o，实时语音对话向所有用户开放

searchSummary.en: GPT-4o (May 2024) made real-time voice conversations with AI available to everyone. OpenAI’s omnimodal model combined text, vision, and audio in one neural network.
searchSummary.zhHans: GPT-4o（2024 年 5 月）让 AI 实时语音对话向所有用户开放。OpenAI 的全模态模型将文本、视觉和音频融合到一个神经网络中。

summary.en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o ('omni'), a natively multimodal model combining text, vision, and audio processing in a single neural network. For the first time, users could have real-time voice conversations with an AI that could express emotion, laugh, pause, and adjust its tone — indistinguishable from human conversation. GPT-4o matched GPT-4 on text benchmarks while dramatically improving voice and vision performance. The model was made free for all ChatGPT users, effectively doubling the available AI capability overnight.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 5 月 13 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-4o（"omni"），一个将文本、视觉和音频处理整合到单一神经网络的原生多模态模型。用户首次可以与 AI 进行实时语音对话——AI 能够表达情感、笑、停顿和调整语气——与人类对话几乎无法区分。GPT-4o 在文本基准上匹配 GPT-4，同时大幅提升了语音和视觉性能。该模型对所有 ChatGPT 用户免费开放，一夜之间将可用的 AI 能力提升了一倍。

narrative.en: GPT-4o was a response to growing competition — Google's Gemini showed native multimodality, Anthropic's Claude 3 matched GPT-4 on reasoning. OpenAI's answer was to make multimodality not just an add-on but the core architecture. The 'o' stood for 'omni.' The live demos were the most impressive part: OpenAI showed GPT-4o interrupting a sung lullaby to adjust its emotion, telling a story with dramatic pauses and voice changes, describing images in real time through a phone camera, and recognizing emotion from facial expressions while talking. The audio latency dropped to 232 milliseconds — close to human conversational response time (about 200ms). GPT-4o also marked a pricing revolution: it was 2x faster and 50% cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo via API. The free tier of ChatGPT got GPT-4o-level intelligence, a move clearly designed to counter Google's free Gemini offerings. The release immediately raised the competitive bar. Anthropic, Google, and Meta all accelerated their multimodal model releases. For users, the impact was immediate: the definition of 'talking to AI' shifted from typing prompts in a text box to having a natural, voice-based conversation with an entity that could see, hear, and respond with human-like emotion.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-4o 是对日益激烈的竞争的回应——Google 的 Gemini 展示了原生多模态，Anthropic 的 Claude 3 在推理上匹配了 GPT-4。OpenAI 的答案是让多模态不仅是一个附加功能，而是核心架构。"o"代表"omni"（全能的）。现场演示是最令人印象深刻的部分：OpenAI 展示了 GPT-4o 打断一首哼唱的摇篮曲以调整情感、用戏剧化的停顿和声音变化讲故事、通过手机摄像头实时描述图像、以及在对话中通过面部表情识别情感。音频延迟降至 232 毫秒——接近人类对话反应时间（约 200 毫秒）。GPT-4o 还标志着一场定价革命：它比 GPT-4 Turbo 快 2 倍且便宜 50%。ChatGPT 的免费层获得了 GPT-4o 级别的智能，这一举措明显旨在对抗 Google 的免费 Gemini 产品。这次发布立即提高了竞争门槛。Anthropic、Google 和 Meta 都加快了他们多模态模型的发布。对用户而言，影响是直接的："与 AI 对话"的定义从在文本框中输入提示转变为与一个能看到、能听到、能以人类般情感回应的实体进行自然的语音对话。

description.en: First production model to natively fuse text, vision, and audio in a single neural network. Real-time voice conversation with emotional expression reached human-like quality for the first time. Audio latency of 232ms was indistinguishable from human conversation.
description.zhHans: 首个在单一神经网络中原生融合文本、视觉和音频的生产模型。带情感表达的实时语音对话首次达到类人质量。232 毫秒的音频延迟与人类对话几乎无法区分。

description.en: GPT-4o-level intelligence became free for all ChatGPT users. API pricing was cut 50% compared to GPT-4 Turbo. The combination of free access + voice interface made state-of-the-art AI conversational ability available to anyone with a smartphone.
description.zhHans: GPT-4o 级别的智能对所有 ChatGPT 用户免费开放。API 价格相比 GPT-4 Turbo 降低 50%。免费访问 + 语音界面的组合使最先进的 AI 对话能力对任何拥有智能手机的人都是可及的。

text.en: OpenAI released GPT-4o on May 13, 2024 — a natively multimodal model combining text, vision, and audio with real-time voice conversation at 232ms latency.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2024 年 5 月 13 日发布 GPT-4o——一个结合文本、视觉和音频的原生多模态模型，具备 232 毫秒延迟的实时语音对话能力。

sources.quote: We're introducing GPT-4o, our new flagship model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time.
GPT-4o (omni) is a multimodal language model developed by OpenAI and released on May 13, 2024.
